verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is a developer-facing payments platform with an official CLI, SDKs and embedded components, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out, privacy control or tracking setting. The CLI probe only confirms that a CLI exists and says nothing about telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
